paper_metadata.title: Precipitation behavior in a Nb-5W-2Mo-1Zr niobium alloy fabricated by electron beam selective melting

The EBSM of Nb521 was performed on the QBeam Lab system developed by Tsinghua University, China. During the EBSM process, the chamber vacuum pressure was controlled at ~2 × 10^3 mBar to minimize oxygen pick-up, and the stainless-steel substrate was preheated by the electron beam up to 1223 K prior to the melting process.
